webster.text: Kind; of a kind disposition; gracious; favorable.

more.text: Generous; liberal; as a benign benefactor.
Favorable; having a salutary influence; as the benign aspect of the seasons.
Wholesome; not pernicious; as a benign medicine.
Favorable; not malignant; as a benign disease.

example.quote: He is also to be authorized to grant "reprieves and pardons for offenses against the United States, except in cases of impeachment." Humanity and good policy conspire to dictate, that the benign prerogative of pardoning should be as little as possible fettered or embarrassed.
